results.raw: False. Jordan’s Legislation & Opinion Bureau publishes draft laws, not the final “قانون الموازنة العامة,” which is enacted by Parliament and published in the Official Gazette.
False. Jordan’s Credit Information Law is Law No. 9 of 2010, not Temporary Law No. 15; the cited source misstates both number and status.

False. No such instructions titled 'تعليمات سجل مسؤولي ومعالجي ومراقبي حماية البيانات' appear on the Jordan Legislation and Opinion Bureau site as of 2025-03-02.
False. Jordan Legislation & Opinion Bureau does not publish laws; it only drafts and reviews them.
False. No such circular exists; the Central Bank of Jordan’s official site shows no record of Circular No. (26/4/5734) dated 19/5/2020.
False. ADGM is Abu Dhabi's financial free zone; Jordan's 2024 budget law is published by Jordan's Official Gazette, not ADGM.
False. DIFC Legal Database covers Dubai International Financial Centre laws, not Jordanian legislation; the cited source cannot publish Jordan’s Credit Information Law.
False. Jordan Securities Commission instructions are not published under that exact title or date; official sources use different phrasing and publication details.
False. The Jordan Legislation and Opinion Bureau has not published any 2026-dated instructions on data-protection officers; the cited date is impossible.
False. The Jordan Legislation & Opinion Bureau does not publish laws dated 2026-06-13; that future date is impossible.
False. The cited circular originates from Jordan’s Central Bank, not Saudi Arabia’s SAMA, so the jurisdiction and publisher are incorrect.
